section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the increasing prevalence of cosmetic procedures in developed countries and reviews literature on correlates of interest in cosmetic surgery, including gender differences, age, attractiveness, media exposure, and body image. The authors introduce the Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS) and its subscales, then describe their present study, which examines the association between the Consider subscale of the ACSS and body appreciation, media influence, weight status, and age. The section does not provide specific study methodology, sample characteristics, or empirical results.
